items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I met him once and didn't see him any more until I came to New York.

ctx.x: And Eddie Heywood Jr. is younger than you?

The first time I saw Eddie Heywood he was living on the West Side. He was about 9 years old. He wasn't even playing. He was living on the West Side. I met him once and didn't see him any more until I came to New York.
